sources.snippet: Part of AIDAM by Jeffrey Romero Del Val — open fact-checking agent; verdicts come from this NLI core plus an auditable aggregator, never from an LLM. sources.title: AIDAM/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md at main · DeliVali/AIDAM · GitHub
sources.snippet: AIDAM architecture AIDAM is not a model: it is a compound system where a small specialized model is the core and every other module is deterministic engineering or tooling. This is deliberate — anything that can be solved with code does not spend parameters.
